name: EPIC 247660165
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 10.9 solar radii and 1.23 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,302 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.23 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,598 K at its surface.
